card.name: Linking words before antiarrhythmic and hormone terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, an, the, be, other, III) and the start of 'exogenous' that sit right before a drug class term. Typical setting is heart-rhythm drugs such as beta blockers, amiodarone and antiarrhythmics.

modes.label: Article before drug class
modes.description: A, an or the just before a drug class or agent description in cardiac text.
modes.example: Amiodarone is<< an>> antiarrhythmic agent with negative chron

modes.description: Class numerals or 'other' right before the word antiarrhythmics.

modes.label: Start of exogenous
modes.description: The 'ex' piece of 'exogenous' in lists of drug interactions.
